rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: OmniSocKit provides structured development knowledge for social marketing platforms directly to AI coding assistants. The server exposes platform-specific skills as MCP resources that AI tools read on demand, covering enterprise WeChat (WeCom) with comprehensive API documentation for OAuth, messaging, customer management, and more. It supports three development modes (internal, ISV, third-party) and includes code templates in five languages. The server operates without API keys or external calls — it purely provides knowledge resources to improve AI-generated code quality for social platform integrations.
